Kya yeh soap sensitive skin ke liye safe hai? ▼
Haan! NaturaGene Sunflower Soap dermatologist tested hai aur all skin types ke liye safe hai — including sensitive skin. No harsh sulfates, no artificial fragrances, no toxins.

Ek soap kitne time tak chalega? ▼
Regular use (twice daily) ke saath ek 150g soap approximately 4–6 weeks tak chalti hai. Soap dish pe rakhein aur paani se dur rakhein — longer lasting rahega.
Results kitne time mein dikhenge? ▼
Most customers 5–7 din mein noticeably softer skin feel karte hain. Skin brightening aur dark spot reduction ke liye 2–4 weeks regular use recommended hai.
